review: The survey states the general distance-independent Transformer attention behavior; STTN gives a bounded sliding-window temporal application. The window limitation must remain explicit.

The DETR background passage explains sequence-wide self-attention, while STTN applies the same attention operation to temporal steps within a sliding window. The tasks and input modalities remain different.
Both passages state that Transformer processing lacks positional information and inject positional encodings; DETR uses fixed encodings and STTN uses learnable spatial and temporal encodings.

Both endpoints explicitly use multi-head attention. STTN explains latent spatial subspaces, while DETR only names the module in an image-sequence encoder, so this is method navigation rather than claim-level evidence.
Both endpoints explicitly use an L1 objective, but for different predicted quantities and training contexts. Keep the formula context attached and use the connection only for loss-family navigation.

The NIST definition covers systems producing predictions, recommendations, or decisions; UMBRELLA explicitly proposes AI predictive models and treatment recommendations for stroke management. This is an instance relation, not evidence of clinical effectiveness.
